zh.title: 美賓州小型飛機與州警直升機相撞致一死二傷
zh.summary: 美國賓州發生塞斯納小型飛機與州警直升機相撞事故，致飛行員死亡及兩名警員受傷。
body: 根據美國媒體發布之消息，美國賓夕法尼亞州發生一起空中相撞事故。一架塞斯納150（Cessna 150）小型飛機與賓夕法尼亞州警察局的一架直升機在空中碰撞，造成一死二傷的嚴重後果。
在本次相撞事故中，塞斯納150小型飛機的飛行員不幸當場罹難。另一方面，賓夕法尼亞州警察直升機上則有兩名州警察人員受傷。
據 Simple Flying 報導，初步訊息顯示該架塞斯納小型飛機當時據報從後方撞擊了警察直升機。美國有線電視新聞網（CNN）與《紐約時報》亦報導了這起空中相撞事件。

en.title: Cessna 150 Collides With Pennsylvania Police Helicopter, Leaving 1 Dead and 2 Injured
en.summary: A Cessna 150 collided with a Pennsylvania police helicopter, killing the plane's pilot and injuring two troopers.
body: A midair collision occurred in Pennsylvania between a Cessna 150 light aircraft and a Pennsylvania State Police helicopter. The incident resulted in one fatality and left two state troopers injured.
The pilot operating the Cessna 150 plane was killed in the crash. Meanwhile, two officers aboard the state police helicopter sustained injuries during the midair accident.

According to reporting from Simple Flying, the small aircraft reportedly struck the police helicopter from behind. Other media outlets, including CNN and The New York Times, also reported on the fatal collision involving the state police helicopter and the light airplane.
